note: Posts live in one Markdown file per month, updates/<YYYY-MM>.md; each post starts with a '## YYYY-MM-DD' line (a time after the date is optional). List a month here once it has its first post. Members are tagged from the names in a post's text (a unit such as MISAMO counts as its members); to set them yourself, end the date line with '| Nayeon, Dahyun'. See updates.js for what a post can contain, including pasted Instagram / X / YouTube links.
